clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Only included when the caller explicitly requests expand=oauth.clientSecret and only for direct-variant plugins (never exposed for backend-proxy variants). Used by the website to complete PKCE token exchanges client-side.

requiresCodeVerifier.description: Whether PKCE code verifier is required

additionalAuthorizeParams.description: Additional query parameters that the website appends to the OAuth2 authorization URL when redirecting the user to the provider's consent screen (e.g., access_type=offline, prompt=consent).

oauthVariant.description: OAuth flow variant. "DIRECT" means the website performs the full PKCE token exchange client-side. "BACKEND_PROXY" means the website sends the authorization code to the Port OS backend, which exchanges it for tokens on behalf of the user.
